build_cuda_extension: build a CUDA C++ extension using CUDAExtension with custom sources and nvcc flags
build_cpp_extension: build a C++ extension using CppExtension with custom sources and compiler flags
build_extension_buildstep: build a setuptools extension using BuildExtension with ninja backend and custom options
create_jit_load_extension: create and load a C++ extension just-in-time from source files using the load function
create_inline_extension: create and load an inline C++ extension from source strings with automatic pybind11 bindings
test_ninja_availability: test whether the ninja build system is available on the current system
test_compiler_compatibility: test whether the compiler is compatible with the current platform and ABI
get_extension_include_paths: get the include paths required to build a C++ or CUDA extension
get_extension_library_paths: get the library paths required to link a C++ or CUDA extension
get_default_build_directory: get the default user-specific build root directory for torch extensions
